items.l1: When he lets go of the toy car, the toy car starts to roll.
items.notes: Exact rendering; low score is synonym spread (放开/松开, 当…的时候/一…就), not looseness.

items.l1: In some places they beat drums to tell stories, and in other places they dance to tell stories.
items.notes: Faithful; back-translations only add an optional 用…来 frame the gold omits.

items.l1: The Reformation changed religion in Europe a great deal.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's 让…变了很多 and 大大改变了 are equally valid renderings of the same claim.

items.l1: Although not everyone could read right away, the number of literate people slowly grew.
items.notes: Faithful; gap is synonym choice (所有人/每个人, 立刻/马上, 读书/识字).

items.l1: It made information easier for ordinary people to obtain.
items.notes: Faithful; gold uses a 被 passive where an active 让普通人更容易获得 is equally correct.

items.l1: Usually, we use servo motors, because they can precisely control the angle of rotation, which is very useful for grabbing small objects.
items.notes: Gold is mixed script: an English gloss （servo motor） sits in parentheses after 舵机; reference is faithful and needs no change once the gloss is dropped from the gold.

items.l1: This "hand" needs to be able to open and close so that it can grab objects.
items.notes: Faithful, quotes kept; gap is 闭合/合上 and 以便/这样才能.

items.l1: We can use a microcontroller, such as an Arduino or a Raspberry Pi.
items.notes: Faithful; gold keeps Raspberry Pi in Latin script where 树莓派 is also standard, and Latin product names are proper nouns, not a defect.

items.l1: You need to connect the motors and the microcontroller, plus sensors if needed, for example to detect whether an object has been grabbed.
items.notes: Same three components, same condition and example; the reference moves sensors last to avoid the gold's mid-sentence parenthetical, a justified reordering.

items.l1: Narrative is not only for entertainment, but can also teach people how to be a good person.
items.notes: 做人的道理 has no tight English idiom; 'how to be a good person' is the natural faithful rendering, and literal alternatives read as stilted.

items.l1: In this way, everyone shares not only the stories, but also feelings and experiences.
items.notes: Faithful; gold repeats 分享 in each clause and uses 情感/经验 where 感情/经历 are equally valid.
Faithful; only difference is 更好看 vs 看起来更漂亮.

items.l1: Many people want to buy nice-looking houses.
items.notes: Gold is topic-comment (好看的房子很多人想买); English SVO is the natural faithful rendering and 很多人想买好看的房子 is equally correct Chinese.

items.l1: With expensive houses, the bosses can earn more money.
items.notes: Gold's 老板 means boss or proprietor, but 'owners' reads as homeowners (房主) and so names a different party; changed 'owners' to 'bosses'.

items.l1: Every night, I hold it in my arms and sleep.
items.notes: Faithful: 'hold it in my arms' maps to 抱在怀里; the gap is just whether 会 and 把 are included.

items.l1: When I am sad, I hold it and feel that it brings me comfort.
items.notes: Faithful; gap is 伤心/难过 and an optional 我会.

items.l1: Every time I see it, I feel a sense of ease and happiness.
items.notes: 安心 means at ease or peace of mind, while 'security' pulls toward 安全感; changed 'security' to 'ease' and kept 'a sense of' to match 一种.

items.l1: We should listen to our bodies.
items.notes: Faithful; 要 and 应该 both carry 'should', and 听身体的话 is matched exactly.
